Hannah C: Putting in notice today. Last day 2026-08-14. I'm on H1-B and have relocation and RSU cliff questions.
Sam P: Sorry to hear that. Can you share email and any PTO? Ill own the handoff.
Hannah C: hannah.c@redwood.com, no PTO. Two scheduled rollouts next week.
People Ops: Thanks Hannah. Quick bullets: 1) We'll send local termination packet and equity/relocation summary. 2) Exit interview (30m) options sent. 3) Benefits for international roles often end on last day  Legal to confirm.
Legal: Confirmed we'll send a note on RSU pro-rata and clawback terms for relocation. Expect DM with details.
IT Ops: Please list any prod tokens or SSH keys. We'll plan phased deprovisioning: rotate keys before last day; SSO disable EOD last day after manager sign-off. Asset pickup arranged via Facilities.
Payroll Bot: Final pay to be processed on 2026-08-31 payroll cycle. Submit expenses by 2026-08-20.
Hannah C: I have one prod API token and two SSH keys on staging. Laptop tag RDW-6023.
Sam P: I'll coordinate freeze of rollouts and take ownership of open tickets. Hannah, pls drop a short runbook in /handovers/hannah-c.
People Ops: Offboarding form created: https://redwood.internal/offboard/2004509876  checklist: benefits, payroll, IT, legal, exit interview. We'll follow up in thread.
Hannah C: Thanks team. I'll add the runbook and accept the exit interview invite.
People Ops: Closing loop when payroll confirms and IT completes deprovision.
